title: Batch-based Bayesian Optimal Experimental Design in Linear Inverse Problems
summary: Experimental design is central to science and engineering. A ubiquitous challenge is how to maximize the value of information obtained from expensive or constrained experimental settings. Bayesian optimal experimental design (OED) provides a principled framework for addressing such questions. In this paper, we study experimental design problems such as the optimization of sensor locations over a continuous domain in the context of linear Bayesian inverse problems.
